EVIDENCE_FAMILY_CAUTION.claim_NOT_made: that ABC links are an independent evidence family relative to Nott PLAC-seq or to NIH-CARD paired RNA-ATAC
EVIDENCE_FAMILY_CAUTION.why: The Activity-By-Contact score is by construction activity x contact. Its activity term shares the accessibility axis with NIH-CARD ATAC and with Nott PU.1 ATAC; its contact term shares the chromatin-contact axis with Nott PLAC-seq. Counting it as a third independent vote would be exactly the resource-counting error the project has already measured against: E2-anchored genes have ~4.92x the microglial detection rate of unanchored measurable genes, so shared expression/openness bias is real in this data and not hypothetical.
EVIDENCE_FAMILY_CAUTION.what_would_have_to_be_measured_first: incremental support P(B|A,X) - P(B|X) with X holding expression, detection, promoter and enhancer accessibility, gene degree, enhancer-TSS distance, cell state, local peak density and locus size
EVIDENCE_FAMILY_CAUTION.also_note: Dong is bulk multi-region brain, not microglia-sorted. Cell-type composition differences are a further shared-bias pathway that must be adjusted for, not assumed away.
